description: Build a Weak Topic Quiz feature that auto-generates targeted practice sessions from incorrect answers. Uses the PracticeAttempt data to identify the weakest topics/modules and creates focused quiz sessions of 10-20 questions from those areas.
steps: Create src/features/question-bank/utils/weak-topic-engine.ts. This module: (1) reads all PracticeAttempts via getAllAttempts(), (2) groups incorrect questions by topic and module, (3) calculates per-topic accuracy and identifies topics below 70% accuracy as 'weak', (4) exports getWeakTopics() returning an array of { topic, subject, accuracy, incorrectCount, questionIds }, (5) exports generateWeakTopicQuiz(count: number) that selects questions from weak topics weighted by how poorly they scored, returning an array of question IDs.

Create src/features/question-bank/components/weak-topic-quiz.tsx - a client component that: (1) calls getWeakTopics() to show a summary of weak areas, (2) has a 'Start Weak Topic Quiz' button that generates a quiz session using the existing QuestionSession type with mode='WeakTopic', (3) uses the existing session-storage.ts saveSession() and navigates to /questions/session/[id]. Follow the pattern in session-configurator.tsx for creating and starting sessions.

Wire the weak-topic-quiz component into the Questions page. In the page that renders SessionConfigurator (look at the (protected) routes), add the WeakTopicQuiz component above or alongside the configurator as a prominent 'Recommended' section, only showing when weak topics exist.
Run bun run tsc --noEmit to verify.
acceptance_criteria: getWeakTopics() correctly identifies topics where user scored below 70%
generateWeakTopicQuiz() returns valid question IDs from the full question bank
WeakTopicQuiz component renders weak topic summary and provides one-click quiz generation
Quiz sessions created with mode='WeakTopic' work with the existing active-test-session.tsx flow
verification: Run: bun run tsc --noEmit - expect exit 0
Run: bun run vitest --run - expect same or better pass count
